summary.text: Front cover of the World Health Organization brochure "Understanding National Health Workforce Accounts".

sections.title: Page 2

summary.text: Defines National Health Workforce Accounts (NHWA) as a system of core indicators and data characteristics designed to standardize health workforce information systems, improve data quality and comparability, and track human resources for health (HRH) policy performance towards Universal Health Coverage (UHC).

sections.extract: + 2 + 1. What is National Health Workforce Accounts (NHWA)? The purpose of the NHWA is to facilitate the standardization of a health workforce information system in order to improve data quality, as well as to support tracking HRH policy performance towards Universal Health Coverage (UHC). The NHWA is built up of core indicators and data characteristics that can be progressively measured in order: • generate

sections.title: Page 3

summary.text: Outlines the national, regional, and global relevance of engaging in NHWA, listing seven core benefits including understanding workforce equity and gaps, informing education scale-up and intersectoral dialogue across health, education, and finance ministries, guiding priority investments, and fostering cross-country data comparability.

sections.extract: + 3 + • A better understanding of the health workforce, including equity and gaps. • Generating quality evidence to inform policy decisions according to country needs. • Ability to guide and inform the transformation and scale-up of health workforce education and training in support of UHC. • Inform intersectoral policy dialogue among the relevant ministries (e.g. education, health and finance). • Inform priority

sections.title: Page 4

summary.text: Presents the global policy rationale and mandate for NHWA within the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development (specifically SDG target 3.c on health financing and health workforce recruitment, training, and retention) and the recommendations of the High-Level Commission on Health Employment and Economic Growth.

sections.extract: + 4 + 3. The 2030 Agenda gives recognition to UHC as key to achieving all other health targets. SDG 3c sets a target to “substantially increase health financing and the recruitment, development, training and retention of the health workforce in developing countries, especially in least developed countries and small island developing States”. The report of the High Level Commission for Health Employment and Economic

sections.title: Page 5

summary.text: Describes the Global Strategy on Human Resources for Health: Workforce 2030 (GSHRH) and World Health Assembly resolution WHA69.19 (May 2016), which urges Member States to consolidate core HRH data for annual reporting to the Global Health Observatory and progressively implement NHWA.

sections.extract: + 5 + WHO and its partners developed the Global Strategy on Human Resources for Health: Workforce 2030 (GSHRH) to accelerate progress towards UHC and the SDGs by ensuring equitable access to health workers within strengthened health systems. In May 2016, the sixty-ninth World Health Assembly endorsed the GSHRH and adopted a resolution (WHA69.19) in support of its implementation. Resolution (WHA69.19) urges Member

sections.title: Page 6

summary.text: Introduces the major health workforce policy questions that NHWA helps answer, covering (1) workforce profile (availability, accessibility, acceptability, and competencies), (2) production and deployment trends, and (3) distribution and productivity gaps by occupation, equity, and skill mix.

sections.extract: + 6 + 4. The NHWA can contribute to finding answers to the following major policy questions related to current HRH challenges and how to optimize planning: 1. Profile: Is the current health workforce available, accessible, acceptable and of the appropriate competencies to provide good quality health services? 2. Production and deployment: What are the trends in the current health workforce in terms production

sections.title: Page 7

summary.text: Continues the list of policy questions addressed by NHWA, covering (4) addressing gaps through resource allocation, retention, and public-private partnerships, (5) improving performance and productivity, (6) balancing domestic workforce production against exits from retirement, mortality, and migration, and (7) evaluating financial incentives for geographical equity in underserved areas.

sections.extract: + 7 + 4. sections.title: Page 8

summary.text: Explains why NHWA uses a health labour market analysis approach, capturing the interplay of four policy domains—workforce production, inflows and outflows, maldistribution and inefficiencies, and private-sector regulation—in achieving equitable access to quality health services.

sections.extract: + 8 + 5. Why a Labour Market analysis approach? The NHWA uses a Labour Market analysis framework. This framework provides a comprehensive picture of health labour market dynamics through the contribution of four groups of health workforce policies – production; inflows and outflows; distribution and inefficiencies; regulation of the private sector – and the interplay these have in ensuring equitable access to

sections.title: Page 9

summary.text: Presents the Health Labour Market Framework for Universal Health Coverage diagram, tracing pathways from high school and health education into the pool of qualified health workers, employment across the health and non-health sectors, migration, and the four targeted policy levers governing production, inflows and outflows, maldistribution and inefficiencies, and private-sector regulation.

sections.title: Page 10

summary.text: Summarizes the stepwise development of the NHWA handbook and indicators through global expert consultations and Technical Advisory Group workshops at WHO headquarters, selecting indicators based on relevance, availability, and national utilization aligned with the health labour market framework.

sections.extract: + 10 + How was the NHWA handbook developed? 6. The NHWA indicators was developed through a stepwise process that included several phases of consultation with experts from around the world, including deans of faculty, academics, teaching instructors, information systems experts, policy planners, and health professionals from both developed and developing countries. Experts of the Technical Advisory Group representing

sections.title: Page 11

summary.text: Describes the structure of the NHWA handbook across 10 modules, each containing policy-relevant numeric and capability indicators covering health workforce regulation, management mechanisms, and HRH monitoring systems.

sections.extract: + 11 + How is the NHWA handbook structured? Each of the 10 modules contains a set of indicators with declared policy relevance. These include both numeric and capability indicators that can provide information on regulation and other mechanisms related to the health workforce, and the status of the HRH monitoring and management system. 7.

sections.title: Page 12

summary.text: Illustrates the 10 modules of the NHWA organized across three overarching domains—Education (Modules 2–4: workforce in education, regulation, and finances), Labour Force (Modules 1 and 5–7: active stock, labour market flows, employment conditions, and spending/remuneration), and Serving Population Health Needs (Modules 8–9: skill mix and performance/productivity)—supported by Module 10 on governance, information systems, and planning.

sections.extract: 10 modules of the NHWA Serving Population Health Needs Labour Force Education Module 2 Health workforce in education Module 7 Health workforce spending and remuneration Module 6 Employment characteristics and working conditions Module 5 Health labour market flows Module 1 Active health workforce stock Module 8 Skill mix compositions for models of care Module 9 Performance and productivity Module 10 Health workforce

summary.text: Provides an example breakdown of indicators in Module 1 (Active health workforce stock), grouped into five sub-areas: sector employment, national and subnational density, activity level and ratio, demographic characteristics (sex, age, median age, dependency on foreign workers), and distribution by facility ownership, facility type, and geography.

narratives.en: The United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) poster grid: three rows of six tiles showing the 17 numbered, colour-coded SDG icons and titles from 1 (No Poverty) to 17 (Partnerships for the Goals), with the Sustainable Development Goals emblem and UN colour wheel in the eighteenth tile at the lower right. Placed in section 3 ('Rationale: Policy frameworks, mandate and context of NHWA') above the discussion of the 2030 Agenda and SDG target 3.c.
narratives.fr: La grille d’affiche des objectifs de développement durable (ODD) de l’Organisation des Nations Unies : trois rangées de six vignettes présentant les 17 icônes et intitulés des ODD numérotés et codés par couleur, de 1 (Pas de pauvreté) à 17 (Partenariats pour la réalisation des objectifs), avec l’emblème des objectifs de développement durable et la roue chromatique des Nations Unies dans la dix-huitième vignette en bas à droite. Placée dans la section 3 (« Rationale: Policy frameworks, mandate and context of NHWA ») au-dessus de l’exposé sur le Programme 2030 et la cible 3.c des ODD.
narratives.es: La cuadrícula del cartel de los Objetivos de Desarrollo Sostenible (ODS) de las Naciones Unidas: tres filas de seis recuadros que muestran los 17 iconos y títulos numerados y codificados por colores de los ODS, del 1 (Fin de la pobreza) al 17 (Alianzas para lograr los objetivos), con el emblema de los Objetivos de Desarrollo Sostenible y el círculo cromático de las Naciones Unidas en el decimoctavo recuadro abajo a la derecha. Situada en la sección 3 («Rationale: Policy frameworks, mandate and context of NHWA») sobre el análisis de la Agenda 2030 y la meta 3.c de los ODS.
narratives.ar: شبكة ملصق أهداف التنمية المستدامة للأمم المتحدة: ثلاثة صفوف من ستة مربعات تعرض أيقونات وعناوين أهداف التنمية المستدامة السبعة عشر المرقمة والمميزة بالألوان من الهدف 1 (القضاء على الفقر) إلى الهدف 17 (عقد الشراكات لتحقيق الأهداف)، مع شعار أهداف التنمية المستدامة وعجلة ألوان الأمم المتحدة في المربع الثامن عشر أسفل اليمين. وُضعت في القسم 3 («المبررات: الأطر السياساتية والولاية وسياق الحسابات الوطنية للقوى العاملة الصحية») أعلى مناقشة خطة عام 2030 والغاية 3-ج من أهداف التنمية المستدامة.
narratives.ru: Сетка плаката Целей в области устойчивого развития (ЦУР) Организации Объединенных Наций: три ряда по шесть плиток с 17 пронумерованными цветными значками и названиями ЦУР от 1 («Ликвидация нищеты») до 17 («Партнерство в интересах устойчивого развития»), а также эмблемой ЦУР и цветовым кругом ООН на восемнадцатой плитке внизу справа. Размещена в разделе 3 («Rationale: Policy frameworks, mandate and context of NHWA») над описанием Повестки дня на период до 2030 года и задачи 3.c ЦУР.
narratives.zh: 联合国可持续发展目标（SDG）海报网格：三行六列共18格，展示从目标1（无贫穷）到目标17（促进目标实现的伙伴关系）的17个编号彩色图标及标题，右下角第18格为可持续发展目标标志与联合国彩轮。置于第3节（“Rationale: Policy frameworks, mandate and context of NHWA”）有关2030年议程与可持续发展目标具体目标3.c的论述上方。

narratives.en: The cover of the World Health Organization publication 'Global strategy on human resources for health: Workforce 2030': a dark teal cover featuring the WHO emblem and wordmark at the upper left, the title in white and orange text, and a swirling circular motif of teal and orange dots below. Placed beside the paragraph describing the endorsement of the Global Strategy by the Sixty-ninth World Health Assembly in resolution WHA69.19.
narratives.fr: La couverture de la publication de l’Organisation mondiale de la Santé « Global strategy on human resources for health: Workforce 2030 » : couverture bleu sarcelle foncé comportant l’emblème et le logotype de l’OMS en haut à gauche, le titre en texte blanc et orange et un motif circulaire tourbillonnant de points bleu sarcelle et orange en dessous. Placée à côté du paragraphe décrivant l’approbation de la Stratégie mondiale par la Soixante-Neuvième Assemblée mondiale de la Santé dans la résolution WHA69.19.
narratives.es: La portada de la publicación de la Organización Mundial de la Salud «Global strategy on human resources for health: Workforce 2030»: cubierta verde azulado oscuro con el emblema y el logotipo de la OMS arriba a la izquierda, el título en texto blanco y naranja, y un motivo circular en espiral de puntos verde azulado y naranja debajo. Situada junto al párrafo que describe la aprobación de la Estrategia Mundial por la 69.ª Asamblea Mundial de la Salud en la resolución WHA69.19.
narratives.ar: غلاف مطبوعة منظمة الصحة العالمية «Global strategy on human resources for health: Workforce 2030»: غلاف بلون أزرق مخضر داكن يحمل شعار المنظمة واسمها في أعلى اليسار، والعنوان بنص أبيض وبرتقالي، وزخرفة دائرية متموجة من النقاط الزرقاء المخضرة والبرتقالية في الأسفل. وُضع بجانب الفقرة التي تصف اعتماد الاستراتيجية العالمية من قِبل جمعية الصحة العالمية التاسعة والستين في القرار ج ص ع69-19.
narratives.ru: Обложка публикации Всемирной организации здравоохранения «Global strategy on human resources for health: Workforce 2030»: темно-бирюзовая обложка с эмблемой и логотипом ВОЗ вверху слева, заголовком белым и оранжевым шрифтом и круговым узором из бирюзовых и оранжевых точек внизу. Размещена рядом с абзацем об одобрении Глобальной стратегии Шестьдесят девятой сессией Всемирной ассамблеи здравоохранения в резолюции WHA69.19.
narratives.zh: 世界卫生组织出版物《Global strategy on human resources for health: Workforce 2030》封面：深青色封面，左上方为世卫组织徽章与字标，中间为白色和橙色标题文字，下方为青色与橙色圆点构成的旋涡状圆形图案。置于阐述第六十九届世界卫生大会以WHA69.19号决议核准该《全球战略》的段落旁。

narratives.en: The cover of the report of the High-Level Commission on Health Employment and Economic Growth, 'Working for health and growth: investing in the health workforce': a light blue and white geometric cover showing the Commission header at top, the title 'WORKING FOR HEALTH AND GROWTH' with a stylized tree icon, the subtitle 'Investing in the health workforce', and triangular inset photographs of health workers and community members.
narratives.fr: La couverture du rapport de la Commission de haut niveau sur l’emploi en santé et la croissance économique, « Working for health and growth: investing in the health workforce » : couverture géométrique bleu clair et blanc présentant l’en-tête de la Commission en haut, le titre « WORKING FOR HEALTH AND GROWTH » accompagné d’une icône d’arbre stylisée, le sous-titre « Investing in the health workforce » et des photographies en médaillons triangulaires de personnels de santé et de membres de la communauté.
narratives.es: La portada del informe de la Comisión de Alto Nivel sobre Empleo en el Ámbito de la Salud y Crecimiento Económico, «Working for health and growth: investing in the health workforce»: cubierta geométrica en azul claro y blanco que muestra el encabezado de la Comisión en la parte superior, el título «WORKING FOR HEALTH AND GROWTH» con el icono estilizado de un árbol, el subtítulo «Investing in the health workforce» y fotografías triangulares insertadas de trabajadores sanitarios y miembros de la comunidad.
narratives.ar: غلاف تقرير اللجنة الرفيعة المستوى المعنية بالعمالة في مجال الصحة والنمو الاقتصادي بعنوان «Working for health and growth: investing in the health workforce»: غلاف هندسي باللونين الأزرق الفاتح والأبيض يظهر فيه ترويسة اللجنة في الأعلى، والعنوان «WORKING FOR HEALTH AND GROWTH» مع أيقونة شجرة مبسطة، والعنوان الفرعي «Investing in the health workforce»، وصور فوتوغرافية مثلثة الشكل لعاملين صحيين وأفراد من المجتمع.
narratives.ru: Обложка доклада Комиссии высокого уровня по вопросам занятости в секторе здравоохранения и экономического роста «Working for health and growth: investing in the health workforce»: геометрическая светло-голубая и белая обложка с шапкой Комиссии вверху, заголовком «WORKING FOR HEALTH AND GROWTH» со стилизованным значком дерева, подзаголовком «Investing in the health workforce» и треугольными фото-вставками с изображением медицинских работников и членов общин.
narratives.zh: 卫生就业和经济增长高级别委员会报告《Working for health and growth: investing in the health workforce》封面：浅蓝与白色几何构图封面，顶部为委员会名称，中间为标题“WORKING FOR HEALTH AND GROWTH”及风格化树木图标、副标题“Investing in the health workforce”，并嵌有多幅三角形卫生工作者与社区居民照片。
